newsitem.title: USA: Data not confirming U.S. productivity pickup-Meyer.
newsitem.headline: Data not confirming U.S. productivity pickup-Meyer.

text.p: Reports from businesses indicate efforts during the late 1980s and early 1990s to boost productivity have paid off but so far the improvements have not shown up in official economic data, Federal Reserve Governor Laurence Meyer said Wednesday.

"There are a variety of reports that we currently get from business people ... that (say) they are seeing a significant increase in their production processes because of corporate reorganization and new technology," Meyer said in response to a question from the House Banking Committee.
"It hasn't really shown up in any clear-cut way in the data yet," he added. "I hope that that will occur, but, to me, it is still one of the possibilities but not something that I cannot confirm."
